lines: Every industry has experts who know things no software does.
At tack-jee-oh, we start with them.
We capture what they know, in their own words. More than fourteen hundred statements for Concrete I.Q. alone.
Then we pair our own expert model with a general-purpose AI.
The result: AI products that work like a seasoned pro.
On one live school bid, Concrete I.Q. caught one hundred forty-four thousand, two hundred nineteen dollars of missing steel.
Brick-chure turns a photo into a brick model you can build.
True Record reads government documents aloud.
Hoof Hearted and Pinball Q.R. are both on the App Store now.
Six products. Four industries. And more on the way.
tack-jee-oh. We turn human expertise into AI products.
music: Modern, confident corporate technology underscore for a 50 second product video. Warm synth pads, soft pulsing plucks, light electronic percussion, gentle build, optimistic and premium, no vocals, clean ending.
